source.author: verg
source.text: Disiectam Aeneae, toto videt aequore classem, fluctibus oppressos Troas caelique ruina, nec latuere doli fratrem Iunonis et irae.
source.text_original: Disiectam Aeneae, toto videt aequore classem, / fluctibus oppressos Troas caelique ruina, / nec latuere doli fratrem Iunonis et irae.
source.text_english: He sees Aeneas’ scattered fleet across the whole expanse of sea, the Trojans overwhelmed by the waves and by the collapse of the sky, nor were the guile of Juno’s brother and his wrath hidden.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: Mox taciti patuere doli nec vellera curae esse viro, sed sese odiis immania cogi in freta.
reuse.text_original: Mox taciti patuere doli nec vellera curae / esse viro, sed sese odiis immania cogi / in freta.
reuse.text_english: Soon the hidden treachery became clear, and it was no concern to the man that the fleeces existed, but rather that he himself was being driven by monstrous hatreds into the seas.
